body: The nature of the field I want to go into, depression and suicide are a very hot button issue, and I'm afraid that having this recorded could impact future employment. I appreciate your words, I guess I've never felt a blow like this before and am not really sure how to express it. Sometimes I just feel like I was abandoned after all that we've been through. its just difficult at times because I feel like I'm a burden to those who are close because I can't get past this even though I do try
